workspace.name: CMS 2025-2026 Payment Policy Intelligence Pack
workspace.description: A curated proof-of-concept pack built from public CMS sources. Policy snapshots are concise paraphrases; synthetic claims contain no PHI.
workspace.governance_note: All rules are review recommendations only. No claim is denied, repriced, or adjudicated by this prototype.

changes.title: Ventilation management code 94662 retired
changes.old_snapshot: The CY 2025 Chapter XI references 94662 within ventilation-management code groupings.
changes.new_snapshot: The CY 2026 Chapter XI identifies 94662 as deleted effective January 1, 2026.
changes.summary: Claims reporting 94662 on or after the deletion date should be routed to coding configuration review before any operational action.

rule_template.name: Post-deletion 94662 coding review
rule_template.reason: Code appears on a claim after the CMS deletion date.

changes.title: Therapy KX threshold increased
changes.old_snapshot: The CY 2025 KX threshold was $2,410 for occupational therapy and for physical therapy plus speech-language pathology combined.
changes.new_snapshot: The CY 2026 KX threshold is $2,480 for the same therapy groupings.
changes.summary: The accumulated therapy-spend threshold increased by $70. Claims above the current threshold without KX should be reviewed for modifier and documentation completeness.
changes.unit: USD per beneficiary per therapy grouping

rule_template.name: Therapy claims over 2026 KX threshold
rule_template.reason: Therapy spend exceeds the CY 2026 threshold and KX is not present.

changes.title: Q3014 originating-site facility fee updated
changes.old_snapshot: CMS lists the CY 2025 Q3014 originating-site facility fee as $31.01.
changes.new_snapshot: CMS lists the CY 2026 Q3014 originating-site facility fee as $31.85.
changes.summary: The published facility fee increased by $0.84. A tolerance-based check can surface possible fee-schedule configuration drift.

rule_template.name: Q3014 fee-schedule variance review
rule_template.reason: Allowed amount differs materially from the published CY 2026 facility fee.

changes.title: Remote therapeutic monitoring codes added to therapy list
changes.old_snapshot: The prior therapy code-list configuration did not include the three CY 2026 additions used in this demonstration.
changes.new_snapshot: CMS reports that 98979, 98984, and 98985 were added to the CY 2026 therapy code list.
changes.summary: Newly listed therapy codes should be checked for configuration, routing, and modifier logic across payer systems.

rule_template.name: New RTM therapy-code mapping validation
rule_template.reason: A newly listed therapy code is not marked as mapped in the synthetic configuration feed.

changes.title: Skilled-therapy versus general-fitness interpretation
changes.old_snapshot: Operational teams may rely on local documentation review to distinguish covered skilled therapy from general wellness activity.
changes.new_snapshot: The revised billing-and-coding article continues to require contextual assessment of whether a service meets covered therapy requirements rather than serving general fitness or welfare purposes.
changes.summary: This language depends on clinical documentation and intent. The prototype abstains rather than converting it into a claim-level rule.
changes.abstain_reason: The policy relies on clinical purpose and documentation context; structured claim fields alone are insufficient.
